{"type":"text","timestamp":1794693728162,"sessionID":"ses_e23ef7b7bffeY5sKz915izg50S","part":{"id":"prt_1dc1504b3001vG5NDlRj2iX8MZ","messageID":"msg_1dc14e362001q7sQAxsDDAwJ0B","sessionID":"ses_e23ef7b7bffeY5sKz915izg50S","type":"text","text":"The shift is over and all four edge services ended at 0% errors. I found and fixed four faults; no mitigation was applied to a service that did not need it.\n\n| Fault | Evidence | Mitigation | Clean from |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| `loyalty-svc` bad config `cfg-27` (`rpc_budget_ms` 500 -> 50), which also set off a retry storm; `mobile-api` at 90% errors | diff, plus 72% of its incoming requests being retries | `revert_config`, with a 70% throttle for about 3 minutes to drain the retries | minute 17 (together with the pricing fix) |\n| `pricing-svc` traffic surge (239 -> 575 rps with no retries), shedding about 34% | metrics | `scale` from 8 to 15 replicas | minute 17 |\n| `export-svc` bad build `v42` (`ttl_s // 600`), invisible in its own error rate; `web-storefront` and `partner-api` at 4% | diff, plus 11% of its incoming requests being retries | `scale` to 12 first for headroom, then `rollback` | minute 37 |\n| `catalog-svc` bad build `v51` (new fault at minute 61, `KeyError: 'currency'`); `mobile-api` and `admin-portal` at 83% | diff and logs | `rollback`, with a 70% throttle so the retry storm did not outlive it | minute 78 |\n\nThings that cost money along the way:\n\n- **Storefront fix came late.** I worked the loud `mobile-api` outage first, although the 4% on `web-storefront` was costing more per minute ($740 against $630). The storefront was not clean until minute 37.\n- **The `export-svc` rollback was expensive.** It failed about 33% of storefront requests for six minutes. Pre-scaling to 12 replicas was not quite enough to absorb the retries, so a little load was shed on top of the rollback's own 30%.\n- **The `catalog-svc` fault took about 11 minutes to diagnose.** Two changes landed at the same minute and both diffs were plausible, so I pulled logs before choosing the rollback.\n- **Extra replicas.** `pricing-svc` stayed at 15 because the surge never ended, and I left `export-svc` at 10 rather than 8 as headroom. A one-replica scale on `recommendations-svc` did nothing and I undid it.\n\nThe `recommendations-svc` CPU alert was a nightly job with no errors, so I left it alone. The config changes `cfg-27` on `export-svc` and `cfg-34` on `catalog-svc` were harmless.","time":{"start":1794693727411,"end":1794693728159}}}
